source.label: A synthetic paper with an interaction

text: Twenty patients and eighteen controls performed a Stroop task during fMRI. Patients were 34.2 years old on average. Images were acquired on a 3T scanner.

definition.value: Patients versus controls, for incongruent versus congruent trials, in a whole-brain voxelwise analysis.

value: Patients showed a larger Stroop effect in the anterior cingulate.
The effect held after adjusting for age.

model_representation_notes.value: Group by condition interaction from a 2 × 2 mixed ANOVA.

spans.text: Patients were 34.2 years old on average.
